messages:
sara: Quick sync — we need a single owner checklist for the CloudVendor marketplace launch. I'm consolidating assets and want to avoid last-minute PR surprises.

miguel: I'm happy to own the integration readiness items (SI docs, API keys, test flows). Can we get the final SI partner sign-off by EOD Fri?

olivia: PR/marketing side: I need final hero screenshots, copy for the marketplace listing, and a short customer quote at least 48h before embargo lift. Who's owning screenshots? @ben? :camera:

ben: Yep I can capture screenshots. Need the exact config to reproduce perf numbers — please drop the run config in the shared doc.

nora: PR here — proposed embargo window is 06/10 08:00 PT. We need legal signoff and partner-approved quote by 06/08 17:00 PT or we'll have to delay. Also confirm if CloudVendor requires co-approval of the press release.

sara: CloudVendor requires co-approval per contract. I've pinged their partner manager to fast-track quotes. Linked: https://notion.fake/redwood/marketplace-landing-assets (working doc)

miguel: For SI integration checklist I added: API key rotation, sample terraform, e2e smoke test, and contact for support. If anyone needs the snippet:
```
# smoke test
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/marketplace/test
```

olivia: Pushing marketing timeline:
- 06/05 final copy freeze
- 06/07 creative approvals
- 06/09 publish landing page (internal preview)
- 06/10 08:00 PT embargo lift + press + marketplace live

ben: Engineering note — we need a fallback model routing policy in case the dedicated instance hits quota. Suggest automatic fallback to public-hosted variant with a banner on the listing about failover. That needs to be implemented by 06/08.

nora: If fallback changes the customer-facing SLA language, legal needs to review. @sara please flag.

sara: Flagged legal. Also creating a micro-FAQ for the marketplace listing to cover fallback behavior and data handling. olivia can you slot that into the landing copy?

olivia: Yep will add FAQ. Also adding an ownership table in the doc to avoid overlap.

miguel: Request: Can we schedule a 30-min dry-run w/ CloudVendor and one SI on 06/09 morning to test provisioning and listing metadata?

ben: I'm available 06/09 09:00 PT, will bring logs and a quick health-check script.

nora: PR dry-run on 06/09 10:00 PT to check co-approval flow. If CloudVendor delays approval, we push to standby time 06/11.

sara: Action items recap (adding to doc):
- olivia: landing copy + FAQ + screenshots (due 06/05)
- ben: reproducible perf config + fallback routing (due 06/08)
- miguel: SI verification + smoke tests + dry-run (due 06/09)
- nora: PR draft + embargo management + co-approval chase (due 06/08)
- sara: partner liaison + legal handoff + final checklist collate (due 06/07)

deploy-bot: Reminder: marketplace-ci pipeline will block pushes to production listing if e2e tests fail. See: https://ci.fake/redwood/marketplace (automated)

olivia: One last ask — any customer quote must be approved by CloudVendor. sara please confirm which customer we can feature.

sara: Confirmed with partner PM: use ACME Inc. quote. I've emailed ACME's comms and copied @nora.

miguel: All good from product side. If we keep to deadlines we can launch on 06/10. If any blocker surfaces, call an emergency sync and we'll reassign tasks.

ben: I'll drop the perf config in the doc now.

nora: Will circulate final PR with embargo metadata once quotes are in.

olivia: Thanks team — I'll update the doc and the landing draft tonight. :rocket:
